original_test_intent: Verify each required1G LAN, PDB BMC and dedicated BMC port's Activity LED is OFF during an approved no-traffic interval and blinks green during bounded approved traffic.
original_method: Operator identifies each port, captures a controlled no-traffic baseline, then observes/records LED behavior during a safe bounded stimulus with time-aligned packet counters; traffic is stopped and network/BMC state restored afterward.
manual_activity: Operator physically observes and records every required Activity LED in no-traffic and bounded-traffic states; an approved agent may only provide traffic/counter corroboration.
required_inputs: Approved physical port map for1G LAN, PDB BMC and dedicated BMC NIC
Vendor Activity LED color/blink definition per hardware revision
Known cable/link-partner state and safe no-traffic window
Approved isolated/bounded traffic source, destination, protocol, rate and duration
Qualified operator, video/photo capture and network-impact recovery policy
safety_requirements: Verify correct port and safe physical access
Ensure traffic cannot disrupt management, BMC, storage, cluster or production services
Use bounded approved destination/rate/duration and stop promptly
Stop on unexpected network impact, wrong port, ambiguity, damaged connector or access risk
No automatic link toggle, cable action or power cycle
agent_execution_scope: If authorized, generate/observe only the approved bounded stimulus and collect counters
Organize operator media and correlate timestamps without inventing visual facts
Do not claim LED visibility, flood networks, alter links/cables/power or issue verdict
engineer_actions: Provide port/activity map and safe traffic contract
Ensure independent network/BMC continuity and resolve ambiguous blink/color
Review both-state evidence and issue verdict

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Correct: no command can visually verify blink behavior; physical observation is authoritative.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Manual per-port observation in approved no-traffic and bounded-traffic states, with optional time-aligned packet counters.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: OFF/no activity, green blinking/link and activity, three required port classes and35/35 fields are preserved.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Capture per-port video spanning pre-stimulus, bounded stimulus and post-stimulus states with synchronized counters.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds controlled stimulus, temporal evidence, non-disruption and restoration boundaries.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: None; packet counters cannot replace observation of the physical activity indicator.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Background control traffic can prevent a true OFF state; camera frame rate/exposure can miss blinking, and BMC ports may carry unavoidable management traffic.

project_override_considerations: Project must define an achievable no-traffic condition per port, especially BMC links, and an approved stimulus that does not endanger management connectivity.
expected_evidence: Operator/date, SUT/board/NIC/BMC identities and labeled port map
Vendor Activity LED definition and exact cable/link/power state
Declared no-traffic baseline and packet counters
Per-port timestamped video/photos showing OFF and green blinking behavior
Network-impact/cleanup confirmation, ambiguity notes and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The no-activity OFF and activity-time green-blinking states and required ports are internally consistent. Exact stimulus and port behavior are readiness inputs.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Operator, port map, vendor definition and safe traffic conditions can be supplied; the case is manual rather than inherently blocked.

review_improvement: Defines two controlled temporal states and prevents packet counters or uncontrolled traffic from substituting for physical blink evidence.
independent_technical_reasoning: An Activity LED encodes packet events over time; a still image or link-up flag cannot prove correct blinking. Conversely background ARP, LLDP or BMC management traffic can make the LED blink during an intended idle state. Evidence must therefore align physical video with interface counters and the exact stimulus window for each port.
